approved_by: PROJECT_OWNER + GPT, 2026-09-08: APPROVED_WITH_REQUIRED_EDITS (E1-E6), then corrected the same day per the implementation-architecture review (E7: run_component_lifecycle wording + smoke closure-acceptance checks). headers_to_dict() approved to stay in EvidenceHunter_orderbook.py as a pure HTTP response-header normalization helper; MAX_NEW_FILES remains 4. prerequisite_for: NEXT_DATASET_FORMAL_START (currently PAUSED_PENDING_PREREQUISITE -- not FAIL, not cancelled; its two draft JSONs were deliberately NOT written, because their preconditions bind commit 5fa94c9 and readiness V2, both of which this changeset supersedes)
objective: Close exactly three Day-1 raw-truth completeness gaps so that the first record of a formal Dataset is not permanently missing evidence that cannot be backfilled later.

gaps_to_close.current_behaviour: EvidenceHunter_orderbook.fetch_depth_snapshot() loads bids/asks/lastUpdateId into memory only. The raw REST response is discarded. lastUpdateId reaches disk only via the process-restart discontinuity gap record, i.e. not on ordinary initialization or resync.
gaps_to_close.required_after_fix: On EVERY initialization and EVERY resync: persist the raw REST response VERBATIM -- defined strictly as the HTTP response body bytes/text as received, BEFORE any JSON parsing. Re-serialising the parsed object (json.dumps of the parsed dict) and presenting it as 'raw' is PROHIBITED: it silently launders parser behaviour into what is supposed to be untouched wire truth. Persist alongside it: lastUpdateId, rest_request_id (see E3), request provenance (endpoint, symbol, limit, request instant) and receive provenance (local wall-clock and monotonic receive instants). Frozen design reference: OF2_PRESTART_DESIGN_V1.must_collect_from_day_1 item 'REST initial order-book snapshot + lastUpdateId (every initialization/resync, not just the first)', irrecoverable_if_missing=true, plus frozen principle 5 ('the raw response is retained verbatim, not only the parsed fields').

gaps_to_close.current_behaviour: No NTP/clock-offset sampling exists anywhere in the collector modules.
gaps_to_close.required_after_fix: Persist periodic local clock observations drawn from WINDOWS OS-NATIVE time-synchronization evidence only: the OS's own reported sync state/status and, where the OS provides one, its reported offset -- each with its own observation instant. This changeset does NOT query any external public NTP server; that option is explicitly out of scope this round. When the OS cannot supply a value, the observation is recorded as unavailable/failure with its reason. Fabricating, defaulting, interpolating or carrying forward a previous offset is PROHIBITED. This evidence NEVER adjusts, corrects or smooths any collected timestamp -- OF2_PRESTART_DESIGN_V1 forbids smoothed/averaged timestamps outright.

gaps_to_close.current_behaviour: _rest_request_json() in EvidenceHunter_collector.py and fetch_depth_snapshot() in EvidenceHunter_orderbook.py both discard HTTP status and headers; failures survive only as a CollectorError string, sometimes ending up inside a gap-ledger detail field.
gaps_to_close.required_after_fix: Persist per-request telemetry for every REST request, keyed by a rest_request_id generated per request and shared with any evidence record produced from that same request (E3: a depth_snapshot record and its telemetry record carry the SAME rest_request_id, giving transaction-level provenance). ALLOWED and required content: endpoint path, request class, SANITIZED request parameters, HTTP status, ALL x-mbx-* response headers, Retry-After when present, request and receive instants, and failure provenance for network-level failures. PROHIBITED content (E4, secret-leakage prevention): Authorization headers, API keys, signatures, cookies, and any secret query parameter value. A parameter that cannot be proven non-secret is redacted rather than stored. Frozen design reference: must_collect_from_day_1 item 'REST call HTTP status / rate-limit events', irrecoverable_if_missing=true.

binding_design_constraints: COLLECTOR COLLECTS FACTS. None of the three additions may write a derived, interpretive or research-hypothesis field. No absorption/liquidity/regime/edge labels, no smoothed timestamps, no future-outcome information.

BACKWARD-COMPATIBLE AND ADDITIVE. New behaviour is opt-in via optional parameters/sinks with inert defaults, so that the existing test suites for the modified modules pass UNMODIFIED. If an existing test genuinely must change, that diff is shown for approval before it is made -- it is never edited silently to make a suite green.

NO GAP/RESTART SEMANTIC CHANGE. gap-ledger record schema, recoverability semantics, resync procedure and restart-discontinuity behaviour are untouched. Persisting a snapshot must not alter the order book's resulting state; this must be proven by test, not asserted.

NO NEW PIP DEPENDENCY. Standard library + Windows OS-native time-sync observation only; no new pip dependency and no external NTP query. Adding a dependency would move G7 from carry-forward to must-re-verify and change requirements-collector.txt; if the implementation genuinely cannot avoid one, that is escalated for approval rather than absorbed.

NO SILENT THREAD. Any new long-running periodic component must register through the existing Supervisor public lifecycle/state APIs and implement the same fail-visible STATE_LIFECYCLE_THREAD_CRASHED semantics used by the existing supervised components. Direct reuse of run_component_lifecycle() is not required where that runner is transport-specific (it is WebSocket-specific: url_fn / route_class / stream_name / on_message). EvidenceHunter_collector_supervisor.py itself remains unmodified.

NO SECRET LEAKAGE. REST telemetry stores only the E4 allow-list. Authorization headers, API keys, signatures, cookies and secret query values are never written to any evidence file. EvidenceHunter_config.py is never read, imported or echoed.
RAW MEANS RAW. Any field named or described as a raw payload/response must be the pre-parse bytes/text as received. No re-serialisation, no normalisation, no key reordering, no pretty-printing.

new_evidence_paths.storage_accounting_requirement: E6 PRINCIPLE: ALL collector-persisted evidence bytes must be counted in soak_summary.json's per-stream and totals accounting -- not only the three original raw streams. G5's validator checks totals.raw_bytes == sum of per-stream raw_bytes, so omitting the new streams would keep G5 internally consistent while knowingly understating real storage growth. If the legacy field name raw_bytes is retained for compatibility with the unmodified readiness tool, the summary must carry an explicit note that this field now INCLUDES the new evidence streams (depth_snapshot, clock_observations, rest_telemetry), so no future reader mistakes it for the old three-stream-only quantity.

short_live_smoke_decision.reason: All three fixes are network/OS-facing. Injected fakes cannot prove the real shape of a live Binance depth-snapshot body, the actual x-mbx-* header names present on real responses, or how this specific Windows machine reports its time-sync state. Fixing three permanent Day-1 evidence formats on assumed shapes is the exact failure mode this changeset exists to prevent.

at least ONE clock observation is a SUCCESSFUL Windows OS sync-state/source observation (availability=AVAILABLE with real sync_status). offset_seconds may legitimately be unavailable, but a window in which every observation is UNAVAILABLE / query-failed / parse-failed does NOT satisfy GAP2: recording failures honestly proves we do not fabricate evidence, it does not prove Day-1 clock state was actually captured

cases: GAP1: a snapshot record is persisted on initial sync AND on every resync, containing the verbatim pre-parse response body, lastUpdateId, rest_request_id, request provenance and receive provenance

E2 raw-means-raw: the persisted raw field equals the exact response body as received and is NOT a re-serialisation of the parsed object (proven with a body whose formatting/key order differs from json.dumps output)
E3 transaction provenance: the depth_snapshot record and the REST telemetry record produced by the same request carry the SAME rest_request_id, and ids differ across requests
GAP1 no-semantic-drift: the resulting order-book state is identical with and without the snapshot sink attached (the persistence must be observationally inert to book reconstruction)

E5 clock observation: a successful OS-native observation record carries its observation instant and the OS-reported sync state/status (and offset when the OS supplies one); an unavailable/failed query is recorded explicitly with its reason and NO fabricated, defaulted or carried-forward offset
E5 no-external-NTP: no external NTP/public time server is contacted by the clock observer
GAP2 no-timestamp-mutation: collected record timestamps are byte-identical whether or not a clock observation reports an offset

GAP3: telemetry is written for a successful REST call, for an HTTP error (status captured), and for a network failure (failure provenance captured); all x-mbx-* headers and Retry-After present in a response are captured

E4 no-secret-leakage: given a request carrying an Authorization header, an api key, a signature and a cookie, none of those values appears anywhere in the persisted telemetry, and secret-bearing parameters are redacted
no-derived-fields: none of the three new record types contains any interpretive/research field

new component crash observability: if the periodic clock component's lifecycle thread dies from an uncaught exception, it becomes visible through the existing supervisor mechanism and does not silently continue
